### A Bruised Reed He Will Not Break
Author: Sinclair Ferguson
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/podcasts/things-unseen-with-sinclair-ferguson/a-bruised-reed-he-will-not-break
Passage: Isaiah 42:2-3
Points:
- Isaiah foretold a Servant who would deliver God's people not merely from political exile, but from spiritual bondage to sin.
- Unlike human tendencies to discard damaged reeds or snuff out smoking wicks, Jesus deals gently with the weak and wounded.
- Struggling believers need not fear rejection, because Christ tenderly mends frail lives and fans faint embers into flame.
- Because Jesus endured suffering and overcame the darkness, He possesses the enduring power to sustain and restore His people.

### The Servant of the Lord
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/servant-lord
Passage: Isaiah 42:1-9
Points:
- Israel continually fell short of its calling to serve God in holiness, creating a need for spiritual cleansing and atonement.
- The prophesied Servant cannot be King Cyrus, because a conquering pagan ruler lacks the gentle compassion described in the passage.
- The Servant represents both the ideal Israel and an individual Messiah who renders perfect obedience to the Father.
- Jesus fulfills the Servant's mission by establishing true justice, opening blind eyes, liberating spiritual captives, and redeeming His people.
